{"id":1881651265,"question_id":4129,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 1 week","timestamp":1768125814,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"187 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1881651265/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Number of Centered Subarrays","memory":"88.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int centeredSubarrays(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();    \n        int count = 0;\n        set<int>st;\n\n        for(int i =0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            int sum = 0;\n            for(int j =i ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                st.insert(nums[j]);\n                sum += nums[j];\n                if(st.count(sum)) count++;\n            }\n            st.clear();\n        }\n    return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"number-of-centered-subarrays","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1474}
